runs.question: What fine does OMB M-25-21 set for an agency that misses its AI strategy deadline?

answer.text:
OMB M-25-21 doesn't set a fine or any other penalty for missing the AI strategy deadline. I searched the memo and found no such provision.

The memo does set the deadline itself. Within 180 days of the memo's issuance, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to responsible use of AI and for achieving enterprise-wide improvements in the maturity of their applications. The memo also says the requirement applies to CFO Act agencies except the Department of Defense, and does not apply to elements of the Intelligence Community.

The memo also tells agencies to use the AI Strategies template, to be provided by OMB, and make their AI Strategies publicly available. My searches did not turn up any consequences for missing the deadline.

Passage states the requirement applies to CFO Act agencies except DoD and not to Intelligence Community elements.
Passage says agencies must use the OMB-provided template and make strategies publicly (available); the text cut-off matches the claim.
